Trump's actions and Iran's stance on Hormuz Strait covered

Coverage from various outlets focused on former US President Donald Trump's actions and statements, alongside Iran's hardening stance regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Trump was reported to be making a trip to raise funds for Republicans and discuss the economy, and his administration's past actions on electric vehicles and mining industry investments were also noted. Iran, meanwhile, was described as hardening its position on the Strait of Hormuz, vowing to keep it closed until the US ends its war, and preparing for a protracted era of regional conflict. Concerns were also raised about the impact of Trump's administration on US climate science.
